summary: A safety helmet: a smooth ABS dome with three moulded crown ribs, a full brim, and a chin strap. options channel0, channel1; sockets grip_r, grip_l, holster_r, sling_back.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.garment_head_hardhat or place "prefab": "garment_head_hardhat" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
